title: Mechanical Engineer
normalized_text:
Job Title: Mechanical Design Engineer
Location: Thrissur, Kerala

Job Description
We need a mechanical engineer with 3-5 years of experience in automotive component design.

REQUIREMENTS
- Proficiency in SolidWorks and AutoCAD
- Experience with GD&T and DFMEA processes
- Understanding of Lean Manufacturing principles
- B.Tech / B.E in Mechanical Engineering

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Design and validate automotive components
- Lead root cause analysis for field failures
- Work with cross-functional teams on new product introductions

NICE TO HAVE
- Certified SolidWorks Associate (CSWA)
